svg.title: Omega × ASI
svg.desc: Start with the ELI16 executive summary, then all fifteen module responsibilities and the exercised dependency maps. M1 established replaceable ports and independent commits; M1.2 connected real Hive; M2 added private memory and guarded revision; M3 adds independent short-term attention and bounded inference over an explicit workset. Suggested delivery: 40–45 minutes through slide 32; eight appendices support discussion. Evidence is the clean tested implementation 1af39794649d0ca95cd729c64868202368da1ec4 recorded by c4498ce3047f1283d3a4a3ae3d09b713e7dcf312. This deck update does not rerun integration gates or add runtime behavior.
